ratios.quote: The ABL Revolver requires us to maintain a fixed charge coverage ratio covenant of not less than 1:1 when availability is less than the greater of $47.3 million or 10.0% of the maximum borrowing amount.

At any time that liquidity is less than $100.0 million, the Term Loan requires a maximum consolidated net leverage ratio as of the last day of each fiscal month of 2.50 to 1.00, calculated on a trailing twelve-month basis.

parsed.notes: Both covenants are springing: the ABL FCCR (min 1.0x) applies only when availability is below the greater of $47.3M or 10% of the maximum borrowing amount. The Term Loan net leverage test (max 2.50x, TTM, tested monthly) applies only when liquidity is below $100.0M. The company states it was in compliance with all financial covenants as of August 1, 2026. No actual ratio values are disclosed.
